title: You Lose an Hour of Sleep to Save $4
summary: CGP Grey explains the mess of Daylight Saving Time, including its dubious energy savings and the odd cases like Arizona that opt out. It is a short, simple explainer.
why: HN people link it as the simple go-to explanation of DST and of how irregular time zone rules complicate scheduling.

quote.text: This guy makes absolutely amazing videos on a number of subjects explaining things in really simple terms.
